content: <thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 121.0528, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 120.0455 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₄H₈O₄ (exact mass 120.0423 Da, within a few ppm of the observed value). No other heteroatoms are required to fit the mass. Therefore the molecular formula is C4H8O4.
